title: Palantir Functions and ObjectSet public-behavior parity matrix
scope: Publicly documented behavior only. This does not claim access to Palantir private implementation, infrastructure, source code, or trademarks.

officialSources.contract: ObjectSets are lazy, unordered single-type collections supporting searchable-property filters, search around, set operations, ordering, loading, and aggregation.
Function registry types and language mappings include Object, ObjectSet, Ontology edits, collections, structs, and language-specific scalar types.
Python and TypeScript v2 have first-class OSDK support; their supported platform capabilities are explicit and not identical.
Python functions generate and install a typed Ontology SDK, query through FoundryClient, accept and return typed ObjectSets, and can materialize a DataFrame explicitly.
TypeScript v2 functions are default exports in a repository with first-class OSDK support and explicit supported types.
Object Set Service limits are explicit platform behavior and depend on API generation and operation shape.
A derived property computes a read-only value from linked objects; aggregation is required only when the traversed link has a many cardinality.

capabilities.publicBehavior: ObjectSet inputs defer object loading until a terminal page or aggregation operation.
Python and TypeScript v2 functions use language-specific typed OSDK packages over one permission-scoped Ontology.
gaps: Generated repository package installation/versioning is not yet identical to Palantir Code Repositories.
Interfaces, full media types, external API clients, and every language-specific function registry type are not implemented.

capabilities.publicBehavior: ObjectSets compose searchable-property filters, ordering, bounded loading, and server-side aggregations.
gaps: Phrase, fuzzy, geo, link-presence, KNN, union, intersect, subtract, advanced buckets, and relevance ordering remain planned.
Searchable render-hint enforcement and Palantir's complete bucket/load limits are not yet identical.

capabilities.publicBehavior: A read-only property may follow one link to a scalar target, or aggregate linked targets where the link cardinality can produce many values.
gaps: The declaration supports one link only; Palantir's documented multi-link derived-property paths are not yet represented or executed.
Exact cardinality, collection aggregations, and an OSv2-scale HyperLogLog approximation backend are not implemented.

capabilities.publicBehavior: Search Around transforms a source ObjectSet into an unordered ObjectSet of the linked type, with at most three link operations in the Function-facing contract.
gaps: The local Object Storage v1-compatible path fails at 100,000 distinct results per hop; OSv2's larger limits and Spark fallback are not implemented.
Per-hop traversal filters, complete Functions OSDK vocabulary, and Searchable render-hint enforcement are not implemented.

capabilities.publicBehavior: A generated domain application imports typed Ontology resources and invokes governed Functions through its generated OSDK.
Every publicly documented filter, traversal, set algebra, vector search, loading, ordering, and aggregation operation has matching semantics and limits.
gaps: This is the remaining public-behavior conformance program; no complete parity claim is allowed before every operation has executable proof.
